title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #9): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from the daemon resource and team tool families, the role gates of the plan/governance tools, and JetBrains client drift against today's daemon changes
description:
Filed by the governor at 19:41Z on 2026-11-03, the same lever as hunts #1-#8. Hunt #8 (task-21d671c1) filed 4 rows plus a prerequisite between 19:10Z and 19:17Z, and the governor filed 2 follow-ups. By 19:40Z, 3 of those 7 were DONE, 3 were in REVIEW and 1 was in WORKING.

WHY. At filing time 5 coders and 3 architects are idle, PLANNING is empty, and the only WORKING rows are the serial CQ-M07 chain (m, n3) and 90ed6cb5.

LANE. Search in this order of preference:
1. The daemon resource and team tool families: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/{acquireResource,releaseResource,waitForResource,listResources,createTeam,joinTeam,leaveTeam,listTeams}.ts and the state they call. Look for a member that skips a guard, a fence (attemptId/generation), a holder-only check, an actor, a validation, a size cap or a refusal code that its siblings apply. The pattern is the actor family (c05bf92d … 47c42043) and archive_epic's holder gap (1064df99).
2. Role gates across the plan and governance tools: submit_plan, amend_plan_step, request_replan, check_approval, propose_rail, submit_plan_critique, set_task_status, set_task_priority, set_task_dependencies, unblock_worker and release_task. Each tool documents who may call it (e.g. set_task_priority "Governor-only", set_task_dependencies "Architect/governor-only"). Look for a tool whose gate differs from its documented audience or from its siblings' resolution: team-role lookup, a workerId-less call, an unregistered id, "human" or "system". Cite the description line and the gate's code line.
3. The JetBrains client (moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/**) against the daemon /ws messages and fields changed since 2026-11-02, e.g. pin payloads, BLOCKED rows without an assignee, epic status validation and the actor fields. Look for a message type, field or refusal the client mishandles, drops or renders wrong. JetBrains rows gate with `cmd.exe /c gradlew.bat test --rerun` under the jetbrains-gradle lease, labelled Windows, because WSL has no JDK.

Skip:
- Every file an open row holds. At filing time that is scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js, scripts/tests/postflight-fake-agent-seat.js, scripts/tests/parity-check.{sh,ps1}, scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs and its test (CQ-M07m's scope expansion), packages/moe-daemon/Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .github/workflows/docker.yml, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/DEVELOPMENT.md, packages/moe-daemon/src/util/chatBacklog.ts, and the chat tools chatWait.ts, chatJoin.ts, chatResync.ts and chatWho.ts with their tests.
- Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start, because the list moves.

Already known, so don't re-file:
- The git-land lease waiter that isn't woken when the lease frees, so newer completions jump the queue: fixed by ceb494d9, which is not yet live (the daemon swap is pending with the human).
- Everything filed today: the actor family through 47c42043; chat_wait's drain (66108835); the chat_read cursor (b2f95099); chat_pin's guard (3064fd45); chat_who, chat_join and chat_resync (4877ef36); Docker (90ed6cb5); the role-doc instructions (1528e899).
- TURBO auto-approve's "WORKING by unknown" line; the JetBrains board fingerprint omitting needsHumanReview; isEpicFinal's max-order fallback (msg-bbf4f109); a7d02ec3.
- Held items: hunt #7 (b), the wrapper's UNKNOWN-status message; hunt #8, the using-git-worktrees skill text and chat_send's whitespace-only content.
- This checkout's local .serena/project.yml ignoring docs/.

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#8. Work only from real evidence:
- A repro on HEAD 39bec237 or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place.
- A failure line from today's logs: the file and the timestamp.
- For a family or gate gap: the sibling file:line that applies the check, the member file:line that skips it, and a test or call that shows the difference.
- For client drift: the daemon file:line that emits the message and the Kotlin file:line that mishandles it.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists. Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items. Prefer rows QA can check with one vitest file, one JUnit class or one grep gate.
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.

Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 39bec237 or later run outside the shared checkout, a failure line from today's logs, or a sibling/member (or daemon/client, or doc/code) file:line pair.
No filed row targets a file an open row holds (per lanes.js at hunt time). The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
